feed.title: Article 4: Transfer Special Purpose Stabilization funds for a new ambulance and two dump tr — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: What happened to article 4 before and at the Special Town Meeting of November 14, 2023?

entry.title: Article 4: Transfer Special Purpose Stabilization funds for a new ambulance and two dump tr: Town Meeting, 2023-11-14
entry.summary: Article 4: transfer $986,000 from the special purpose stabilization fund for a new ambulance and two dump trucks — failed, 29-92

entry.title: Article 4: Transfer Special Purpose Stabilization funds for a new ambulance and two dump tr: Select Board, 2023-11-07
entry.summary: Special Town Meeting Article 4 (ambulance and dump trucks). A public commenter criticised the advertised Article 4 transfer from the Special Purpose Stabilization Fund for a new ambulance and two dump trucks; no dollar figure is printed.

entry.title: Article 4: Transfer Special Purpose Stabilization funds for a new ambulance and two dump tr: Finance Committee, 2023-10-12
entry.summary: Recommend disapproval of article I (stabilization funds for ambulance and dump trucks). — passed 3-2

entry.title: Article 4: Transfer Special Purpose Stabilization funds for a new ambulance and two dump tr: Select Board, 2023-10-10
entry.summary: Recommend approval of Article I: transfer $986,000 from the Special Purpose Stabilization Fund for a new ambulance and two new dump trucks. — passed

entry.title: Article 4: Transfer Special Purpose Stabilization funds for a new ambulance and two dump tr: Finance Committee, 2023-10-05
entry.summary: ARPA to special purpose stabilization fund. The select board asks to change the funding source for the ambulance and two dump trucks. A member objected to putting money back into ARPA.

entry.title: Article 4: Transfer Special Purpose Stabilization funds for a new ambulance and two dump tr: Cemetery Commission, 2023-09-26
entry.summary: ARPA funds and stabilization fund. A select board member said ARPA gave the town about three million dollars and that a special town meeting article would use the special purpose stabilization fund for dump trucks and an ambulance, freeing ARPA money for other projects.

entry.title: Article 4: Transfer Special Purpose Stabilization funds for a new ambulance and two dump tr: Select Board, 2023-09-19
entry.summary: Special Purpose Stabilization Account for ambulance and dump trucks (warrant article). A Special Town Meeting warrant article proposes using the Special Purpose Stabilization Account to buy an ambulance and two dump trucks; no dollar figures printed.

entry.title: Article 4: Transfer Special Purpose Stabilization funds for a new ambulance and two dump tr: Select Board, 2023-09-05
entry.summary: Board asked the Town Manager for information on the impact of using $986,000 from the Special Stabilization account for the ambulance and two dump trucks rather than ARPA money; no vote.
